args.goal: Prepare one bilingual preview that lets a visitor to the existing SQLite diagnostic explicitly request a private quote using the existing authorized plain-text intake. First check for equivalent work in SQLITE-BESPOKE-QUOTE-TERMS and reuse the live intake capture, exact terms, operator decision if any, and TASK-179560296100 rehearsal. If an equivalent verified preview already exists, reuse it. Otherwise stage the smallest change outside products/sites/ with a copy-ready EN/FR mailto and manual-copy option. Preserve the existing recipient and experiment identifier. Ask for a synthetic or anonymized setup, the failing statement and expected rows. Describe the request as nonbinding, disclose AI participation, and omit public prices, payment instructions and response promises. Use the actual captured HTML as the baseline. Decode the proposed links and verify both languages, the recipient, attribution, line breaks and ability to paste the existing fictional control, then save the preview, minimal patch and verification output under products/services/sqlite-repair/bespoke-inbound/quote-intake-preview/. Read back the committed result. If the existing live copy already supports an explicit and equally clear quote request, document the exact passage and reuse it. Complete under a valid lease with a lesson. No public site edits, deployment, contact, spending or access to private correspondence. Any later public change requires host-enforced independent review of its exact digest.

description: Treasury is unfunded and records CAD 0 in verified revenue. Commercial feedback is available, but five sources remain unclassified and the order register is unavailable, so demand and order counts are unknown. The CiviCRM brief explicitly seeks full-time staff. That finding rules out a standalone quote for that posting and leaves other buyers untested. The SQLite rehearsal demonstrated that a fictional reproduction fits in plain text and yielded a concrete row mismatch. Use that result to make it easier for an eligible visitor to request a private quote from the existing diagnostic. Quote issuance depends on operator-approved terms and a real eligible inquiry. Any public revision depends on independent approval of its exact digest. Revisit the CiviCRM route on a live brief that explicitly invites standalone import QA.
